scope: Actual unchanged PlasticCraft 2.1.3 boats and C4 with one native remote client and a separate dedicated server; generic explosion correction and native controls.
generic_changes: Legacy World.createExplosion without a source uses native BLOCK explosion interaction; explicit sources retain their existing MOB interaction.
The original mods still own boat movement, riding, damage/drop, fuse, priming, defusing, wear and custom saved NBT. No production mod-identity selector was added.
Headless graphical test instructions now require a silent backend and zero master volume in the disposable test profile; user Prism audio settings are preserved.

causal_baseline.false_gamerule_old_behavior: Natural C4 detonates and damages native pig but leaves all1875floor cells intact; original null source was incorrectly classified as MOB.

corrections: Initial dock pitch30 put water surface beyond the original 5-block ray reach; repeat with pitch45. Initial placement assertion is exploratory fixture calibration, not a product defect.
Moving client/server snapshots are sequential: initial horizontal comparison ignored 9 elapsed ticks of coasting. Repeat using timestamps and a settled boat; no product defect established.

Initial reconnect readiness checked player/world presence while ReceivingLevelScreen was still active. Authoritative rider already restored; wait for loaded terrain and tracked boat before client assertions.

Unarmed break probes were spaced longer than original boat damage decay; repeated damage reached zero between probes. Use one sufficiently strong native iron-sword attack for the original >40 accumulated-damage threshold.
Lever center aim at Y70.5 missed its native low collision shape; authoritative lever stayed OFF. Aim at native lever base Y70.125 and use empty hand.

Explosion damage-source inspection initially occurred more than40 native ticks after blast, after vanilla clears lastDamageSource. Poll authoritative completion and capture damage source in the same server tick; health9 from initial10 was already observed.

Final sword attempt began while the dismounted player was sinking; camera alignment changed relative to boat before native ray picking, so attack had no entity hit. Repeat from stable native stone footing and assert actual crosshair UUID first.

boundaries: One real remote client socket is exercised; simultaneous two-client interactions are not claimed.
Original enhancedC4=false and120-tick fuse options remain unchanged. Optional enhanced-mode behavior and primed-C4 disk reload are not established by these checks.

Placed and multiple-air-defuse cases precede the explosion-only patch; listed callback sources are byte-for-byte unchanged after line-ending normalization. Boats and both gamerule explosion cases are rerun on the final artifact.
Native Creeper and TNT controls use their own unmodified30/80-tick fuses and native lifecycle, without direct explosion calls, AI changes or attribute edits.
Fixture preparation uses isolated native block/player/inventory/camera APIs. No original gameplay callback is invoked manually and no fuse is shortened.
Private archives, generated game caches/worlds and local helper scripts are not committed or required by the default build.

Earlier fixture-calibration failures are retained separately, including reach, sequential snapshot timing, early world reception, damage-source expiry, lever shape and moving camera alignment. They are excluded from acceptance assertions.
